staticText: Private Feeding and Nappy Log for /tools/breastfeeding-tracker/. It records user-entered breastfeeding, expressed-milk, wet-nappy and stool events only in memory in the current page. It must never infer milk transfer, milk supply, feeding adequacy, hydration, weight gain, illness, a normal feeding duration or a diagnosis from counts, times, sides, pumped amounts or nappy events. It must never discourage mixed feeding, prescribe feeding frequency, recommend stopping or changing a clinician-directed feeding plan, or delay urgent care. A baby who cannot feed or stopped feeding well, is hard to wake, has difficult breathing, abnormal blue/pale/grey colour, seizure or much drier nappies needs prompt local medical assessment. Parent fever or flu-like illness with a hot, swollen, painful breast also needs professional attention. Family feeding data is sensitive: never silently persist it, put it in URLs, send it to analytics, upload, sync or require an account. Local exports are user initiated and should carry the safety and privacy boundary.
